scope: Correct tracked paid launcher activation identity preflight; validate centrally activated deployment record without requiring an unknowable predeployment URL. Preview-only, no paid activation.
riskAnalysis: An immutable deployment URL is assigned after configuration. Removing the impossible env-field requirement must retain exact source, release, task, approval hash, runtime, active lease and expiry checks before dependencies and provider dispatch.

threatModel.assets: Current owner session, task capabilities, isolated project key, immutable task/evidence/QA records, historical spending holds and durable approval registry.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Authenticated owner browser to protected Node supervisor and Redis; restricted worker to exact task APIs and OpenAI; provider output to independent QA and backend acceptance.
threatModel.abuseCases: Wrong deployment, mismatched task/hash/release, malformed lease, revoked or consumed authorization, unavailable Redis, cancellation and revocation during dependency checks.
threatModel.mitigations: Fresh guarded broker GET before dependencies; exact activated central record comparison; optional explicit deployment binding retained; existing driver and backend repeat authority checks; unchanged fallback revocation.

rollback: Keep paid false; remove only temporary inert window; deploy exact reviewed disabled feature source and independently verify old/current/replacement brokers. Preserve original helper bytes, task records and uncertain holds. Revert feature-only reviewed changes if required, never Production or historical evidence.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Actual launcher denies missing record, invalid lifecycle version and missing/NaN/string lease before dependency startup. Existing provider malformed response regressions remain unchanged.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact source/release/approval hash/task/deployment comparisons reject stale records; driver and backend repeat these checks after startup.
negativePaths.concurrency: Only active unused record admitted; consumed/revoked records denied, existing atomic initialize/CAS replay protections unchanged.
negativePaths.cancellation: Existing parent cancellation and supervisor cancellation regressions retained; launcher signal feeds bounded broker read and dependency checks.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Existing restricted process interruption and bound cleanup tests reused; no new child process permissions or retry introduced.
negativePaths.api-outage: Actual launcher synthetic storage unavailability rejects before provider, reports shutdown unconfirmed and owner cleanup required rather than fabricating revocation.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Actual launcher rejects foreign task/hash/runtime and disabled paid contexts; exact synthetic lifecycle verifies fallback revocation.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No spending code modified. Existing contract and full budget regressions retained; fresh hosted ledger remains15/7/2.2/8 with no new reservation.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Valid activated record with deliberate missing browser reaches dependency failure and centrally revokes before task/provider initialization; historical counterfactual fails before record read.

defects.rootCause: Paid launch.run required approval.deploymentOrigin before immutable Vercel URL exists; backend correctly assigns the authoritative binding at activation.
defects.detectionGap: Hosted rehearsals covered nonbillable launch mode; paid composition tests called driver.run directly and skipped the distinct paid launcher gate.
defects.regression: Mandatory actual launch.run tests with synthetic approval lacking deploymentOrigin and real in-memory lifecycle activation; malformed and mismatched records trapped before provider.
defects.historicalPrevention: Original launcher rejects the valid activated record before reading it; the new boundary regression must fail against original source. No paid failure or cost was incurred.

proactiveReview.architecture: Same authenticated owner supervisor, central Redis lifecycle and restricted launcher. No new authorization route or executor; only source of deployment binding changes from nonexistent config field to activated record.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing Vercel Pro/Fluid duration, Upstash CAS, owner session, restricted worker project credentials, native Responses contract and current official pricing reviewed.
proactiveReview.threats: Profile confusion, orphan activation, callback substitution, leaked task capability, replay/stale deployment/release, controller interruption, authority renewal after revoke, and partial initialization.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Predeployment URL circularity confirmed. New tests cover active record mismatch and invalid lease; downstream checks remain authoritative if revocation races dependency startup.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Lost committed reply, ignored abort, concurrent sequence, lifecycle revoke/expire/deployment/release/stagedeadline, Chief ownrenew and unrelatedsnapshot mutation; actualparent long35scapture uses only providerresponse substitutes.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Auditor found circular binding; requested integer lease/version/optional mismatch checks. Separate QA authors actual-launcher tests independently.
proactiveReview.recovery: Central exact-ID revocation before/after init, cleanup readback validation, hardkill lease fallback, no retries, pending usage preserved and separate replacement verification.
proactiveReview.readiness: No paid pilot after this material source change. Require independent review, targeted/full/contract/Redis CI CodeQL and disabled hosted verification before fresh authorization.
